proxy_routes: first 10 distinct eligible configured worker routes
transport: Native SocksiPyConnectionS/stdlib TLS with production headers and Connection keep-alive
measurement: Encrypted external TCP payload, both directions; includes SOCKS negotiation and TLS handshakes.
excluded: DNS, TCP/IP/link headers and TCP retransmissions; other apps, health checks and browser traffic.
application_state: No production code, queues, payments, wallets or customer jobs changed.
privacy: No account identifiers, amounts, bodies, proxy addresses or credentials in reports.
